headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 18, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 8-2 behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo. Alec Bohm led the Phillies' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI. The Kansas City Royals dropped a 4-6 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Nationals' offense. Curtis Mead led the Royals with a home run and three RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries. Cole Ragans has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Kansas City Royals due to left elbow impingement. Spencer Strider has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Atlanta Braves due to right elbow inflammation. Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Cleveland Guardians with a right side rib fracture. Max Scherzer has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to back spasms.

There have been several trades and roster movements. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Phillies Rout Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 8-2 behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo, who earned the win with 7.0 IP, 9 K, and 2 ER. Alec Bohm led the Phillies' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 4-6 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Nationals' offense. Curtis Mead led the Royals with a home run and three RBIs, while Foster Griffin pitched 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by George Springer's impressive performance at the plate. Springer hit a home run, his seventh of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds in a one-sided matchup, securing a 9-1 victory. Impact players for the Mets included Francisco Alvarez, who contributed to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Carter Jensen and Michael Massey contributing to the winning effort. Lane Thomas and John Rave also had notable performances for their respective teams.

top_news.title: **Royals Pitcher Cole Ragans Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals left-handed pitcher Cole Ragans has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow impingement. This move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Mariners Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash on June 17, 2026.
